blocks.text: The primary objectives of the Scientific Library are:
Forming the library collection with educational literature on both traditional (print) and electronic media;
Providing access to the resources of the global information space;
Creating optimal conditions for readers to work with educational information.
The unified library fund consists of various types of domestic and foreign publications (scientific, educational, fiction literature, etc.), as well as audiovisual and electronic documents.

Books in the reading rooms are available in open-access mode. Books from the lending sections may be borrowed for home use. The library collections of the faculties – KCF (FKF), KKF, FITEI (FIIT), RPF (FRF), and FOLIR (FVMO) – are located in the main building of BMU; SPF (SPF), FEB (FEM), and the Institute of Continuing Professional Education (INDO) are located in Building No. 2; FEF (FEF) and the College are located in Building No. 3. The general reading room in the main building contains the following periodicals: newspapers – 20 titles, journals – 4 titles, and reference literature – 1,600 books.

The library actively develops and supports an interest in books and reading through exhibitions, literature reviews, and thematic viewings, alongside organizing events aimed at elevating the general culture of students. Students have access to a convenient and efficient information search via the electronic catalog system, where they can look up books as well as articles published in newspapers and journals.

Students have access to a convenient and efficient information search system through electronic catalogs, where they can obtain information about books as well as articles published in newspapers and journals.
Collection Size: The library's print collection holds 258,876 copies of educational, scientific, and fiction literature in Kyrgyz, Russian, and foreign languages.
Electronic Catalog: Core literature is logged in the library's Electronic Catalog, which contains 49,650 bibliographic descriptions of books (with continuous logging since 2003).

Online University Library ELS (Electronic Library System) https://biblioclub.ruAccess to this system has been active since November 20, 2019. The resource contains textbooks, study guides, monographs, periodicals, handbooks, dictionaries, encyclopedias, video/audio materials, illustrated art editions, and fiction. • Scope: It provides access to more than 100,000 publications across all fields of knowledge from over 400 publishing houses, ensuring coverage for both core and highly specialized subjects. Readers are permitted to print out individual pages of required books and journals.User Registration Steps for biblioclub.ru: Obtain a personal BSU user account page. Receive a login and password to access the website Once registered, readers can log into the Online University Library from any location.
Kyrlibnet: Open archive searches can be performed through the website kyrlibnet.kg.
Information regarding electronic resources for dissertations and author abstracts can be found on the website of the National Library of the Kyrgyz Republic named after A. Osmonov: nlkr.gov.kg.
The BSU Scientific Library's electronic catalog, reference books, encyclopedias, journals, and newspapers are physically accessible in the reading room of the main campus building.
Sanitary Day: The last Wednesday of every month (Closed for maintenance).
Governed by the Regulations on the Scientific Library of BSU.
